fabric-datatype-double|fabric-datatype-f.notes: The double has a closed D suffix while the float has an open F suffix; both remain readable at 32px.

fabric-curved-right-circle|m365-number-c.notes: The numeral has a closed triangular upper stroke and vertical stem; the curved arrow has a bent shaft and pointed arrowhead, including at 32px.

m365-arrow-circle-left|m365-arrow-circle.notes: The arrowheads point in opposite directions, including at 32px.

m365-chevron-circle|m365-dismiss-circle.notes: The chevron is an open right-pointing angle; dismiss has two crossing strokes.

m365-check-circle|m365-dismiss-circle.notes: The angled check and crossed strokes remain different at 32px.

m365-number-circle-three|m365-number-cir.notes: The numerals have different contours: the two has a diagonal baseline and the three has two curved lobes.

m365-check-circle|m365-chevron-circle.notes: The check descends then rises; the chevron points right with a central vertex.

fabric-arrow-trend|m365-arrow-circle-lef.notes: The left-pointing straight arrow and rising zigzag arrow have different direction and contours at 32px.

fabric-asterisk-circle|fabric-commit-cir.notes: Six intersecting spokes differ from the single circular revision node on a vertical line, including at 32px.

fabric-locked-columns|fabric-locked-rows.notes: The layout dividers are vertical for columns and horizontal for rows, including at 32px.
